dynamic_prepared_scan_before_slip.generic_bound: unproven because distinct same-role concurrent operations are not protocol-bounded

accepted_in_tested_scope.protocol: one deterministic current admission slot per role, with operation_id, slot incarnation, monotonic epoch, and current-blob CAS; only the slot head may be authoritative PREPARED; wide REQUESTED ticket stops new cooperative admissions, and wide retry budget may use the structural number of slots as the maximum count of pre-ticket admission slips
accepted_in_tested_scope.why_role_count_becomes_a_protocol_bound: not because the scheduler guarantees one invocation per role, but because overlapping invocations for the same role contend on one current slot and only one can be PREPARED
accepted_in_tested_scope.same_role_overlap: losers fail closed or enter a bounded non-authoritative queue; they do not create additional authoritative PREPARED work
accepted_in_tested_scope.response_loss: read back current slot and reconcile operation_id/epoch rather than blind retry
accepted_in_tested_scope.crash_before_release: leaves slot occupied; progress requires a later fenced takeover to a higher epoch
accepted_in_tested_scope.late_release_after_takeover: rejected by current blob/epoch; slot incarnation prevents delete-recreate ABA in the tested no-complete-rewind scope

not_accepted_or_unresolved.scheduler_role_count_alone: does not prove max_inflight; public task documentation found specifies active-task limits and run-frequency limits, not a one-inflight-per-task mutual-exclusion guarantee
not_accepted_or_unresolved.dynamic_prepared_file_scan: a snapshot of currently visible PREPARED records is not a structural upper bound because pre-ticket readers can create new records after the scan and same-role distinct operations are not bounded by protocol
not_accepted_or_unresolved.logical_name_only_slot: delete/recreate can reintroduce ABA unless incarnation changes the current bytes/witness
not_accepted_or_unresolved.crash_without_takeover: finite safety bound remains, but wide progress can be blocked indefinitely; finite liveness still depends on the Part-42 recovery transition budget
not_accepted_or_unresolved.complete_repository_rewind: if slot incarnation/retirement witness and all authority bytes rewind together, this repository-local scheme cannot distinguish the old world
not_accepted_or_unresolved.noncooperative_workers: a worker that can publish authoritative effects without acquiring its role slot is outside the proof
not_accepted_or_unresolved.base_scheduled_task_quota: the mechanism adds no optional hosted compute or monthly credit dependency, but current public OpenAI documentation says plan usage limits apply to scheduled tasks; therefore task-plan limits are not used as a correctness or finite-inflight proof

zero_dependency_zero_quota_assessment.repository_rate_limits: treated as interruption; before slot CAS no authority is admitted, after response loss current slot readback reconciles, and later scheduled invocation may continue
zero_dependency_zero_quota_assessment.scope_note: repository APIs are transport only; no GitHub Actions/Codespaces/LFS/artifact/package/cloud compute route is used

public_source_observations.observation: current public documentation describes scheduled-task active limits and a maximum run frequency, but the page located in this run does not state a mutual-exclusion or maximum-overlapping-invocation guarantee usable as max_inflight
updating a file requires the blob sha of the file being replaced; concurrent content operations can conflict
rate-limit responses require stopping/retrying later rather than continuous blind retries

exact_continuation: Next leaf: test the structural role-slot bound under role membership changes and pool reconfiguration. Enumerate role add/remove/re-add, slot namespace migration, role rename, slot creation response loss, disabled-but-stale slot, new role appearing after wide REQUESTED, and control-revision change after semantic freeze. Compare fixed 11-slot snapshot, membership-epoch + slot set, append-only role-incarnation registry, and a global root. Target a zero-global-write proof that a wide ticket can bind a finite current slot membership set without allowing post-ticket phantom roles.
